heading: FAQ’s on Car Wash App Development Solutions

items.question: Can the app be customised to our business model?
items.answer: Yes. As a white label solution it can be branded and extended to match how your car wash business works.

items.question: How long does it take to launch?
items.answer: A branded launch typically takes 6–8 weeks. Timelines depend on customisation and extra features; we agree a plan after reviewing your requirements.

items.question: How much does a car wash app cost?
items.answer: Pricing depends on the features and customisation you need. Share your requirements and we will provide a clear estimate.

items.question: Do you provide unique branding?
items.answer: Yes. From the logo to colour themes and screens, we customise the app to look like your own product.

items.question: Can I run a mobile wash and station-based service together?
items.answer: Yes. The platform supports both on-demand mobile washes and slot booking at stations.

items.question: Does the app support multiple languages and currencies?
items.answer: Yes. Language packs and multi-currency settings are available from the admin panel.
